title: Endpoint power weight inequalities for spherical maximal functions in Lean
summary: This is a Lean 4 formalization of Theorems 1.1-1.4 from the paper "Endpoint power weight inequalities for spherical maximal functions" by M. Fraccaroli, J. Lee, N. Lei, J. Roos and A. Seeger. The theorem statements were human-written, while the proof was automatically generated directly from the paper using coding agents.
